items.title: Measuring LLMs' Impact on N-Day Exploits: Mythos Preview Builds 8 Firefox + 8 Windows Kernel Exploits Autonomously
items.title_zh: 大语言模型对N-Day漏洞利用的影响：Mythos Preview自主构建8个Firefox和8个Windows内核漏洞利用
items.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team evaluated LLMs on N-day exploit development (weaponizing already-patched vulnerabilities before fixes reach affected systems). Across 18 Firefox patches, Mythos Preview built 8 working exploits autonomously—the first in under one hour. On 21 Windows kernel patches (binary-only, no source), it produced 8 full SYSTEM-level privilege escalation chains at ~$2,000/exploit in API credits. Mythos Preview produced crashes for 13 of 14 bugs Microsoft rated 'Exploitation Less Likely/Unlikely.' The typical patching playbook—monthly cycles, multi-week rollouts—no longer holds; the exploit bottleneck has collapsed to hours, not expert-weeks.

items.title: SkillOpt: Agent Skills as Trainable Parameters — +23.5 Point Improvement, Open-Source from Microsoft Research
items.title_zh: SkillOpt：Agent技能参数化训练 — 微软研究院开源，提升23.5分
items.summary: Microsoft Research proposes SkillOpt, treating agent skill files as trainable parameters with a full optimization loop: batch execution, trajectory reflection, bounded text edits, validation gating, and slow/meta updates. Best or tied-best in all 52 evaluation cells across 6 benchmarks, 7 models, 3 execution modes. GPT-5.5 average rose from 58.8 to 82.3. Qwen3.5-4B surpassed GPT-5.2. Skills transfer across harnesses: Codex-trained spreadsheet skill boosted Claude Code from 22.1 to 81.8. Compact ~920-token skill files from 1-4 accepted edits.

items.title: Project Fetch Phase Two: Claude Opus 4.7 Robodog 20x Faster Than Humans — Early Physical Agentic AI
items.title_zh: Project Fetch第二阶段：Claude Opus 4.7机器狗比人类快20倍 — 物理Agent AI的早期信号
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.7 operated a robotic quadruped autonomously, ~20x faster than humans from Phase One. Completed tasks ~37x faster than the Claude-less team. Still struggles with precise physical manipulation. The trajectory mirrors coding agents, signaling the early era of physical agentic AI.

items.title: Paving the Way for AI Agents in Biology: gget virus Deterministic Layer Boosts Accuracy from 16-91% to 99.7%
items.title_zh: 为生物学AI Agent铺路：gget virus确定性检索层将准确率从16-91%提升至99.7%
items.summary: Anthropic benchmarked AI agents on NCBI Virus retrieval (VirBench, 120 queries, 40 pathogens). Frontier models scored 16-91% with high run-to-run variability—one Sonnet 4 run shifted an Ebola outbreak TMRCA from 2014 to 1922. Adding gget virus, a deterministic retrieval layer, raised all agents above 90% (GPT-5.5 at 99.7%) and eliminated variability. The lesson: scientific agents need deterministic data access layers.

items.title: Coding Agents in the Social Sciences: 20% Adoption, 2x Gender Gap, Claude Code at 86%
items.title_zh: 社会科学中的编程Agent：20%采用率，2倍性别差距，Claude Code占86%
items.summary: Anthropic surveyed 1,260 social scientists: 81% have tried AI chatbots, 20% adopted coding agents. Claude Code is dominant (86% of agent users). Economists at 39% vs public health at 6%. Men 2x women. Top-university researchers 40% more likely. Agent users post more working papers and grants, but not yet more journal submissions.

items.title: Anthropic Economic Index: Cadences — Hourly Analysis of Claude Usage Patterns and AI's Impact on Work
items.title_zh: Anthropic经济指数：Cadences — 按小时分析Claude使用模式及AI对工作的影响
items.summary: Anthropic's June 2026 Economic Index samples hourly for the first time, analyzing when people use Claude, what they produce with it, and how they perceive AI's impact on their work across different times of day and task types.
